title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: When pickup runs late
hook: Practice ended twenty minutes ago. One kid is still waiting.
intro: You are standing in the parking lot with one player.
statement: Pickup is part of the season, too.
q1: Do you set a clear pickup policy early —
q2: or handle late pickups one at a time?
q3: Who else stays with you while you wait?
t1: Both can work. But everyone feels safer
cta: Coaches — how do you handle late pickups?
ctaLines: Two adults stay. A text reminder. A set end time.
A policy or case by case?
ctaPrompt: Share your pickup habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Practice ended twenty minutes ago. One kid is still waiting.
Everyone else has gone home. You are standing in the parking lot with one player.
Pickup is part of the season, too.
A clear policy or one at a time. Both can work.
How do you handle late pickups? Share your habit in the comments.
